podcast.title: Co-Creator of Jesus Christ Superstar
podcast.body: Tim Rice co-created the musical *Jesus Christ Superstar* with Andrew Lloyd Webber. Due to a lack of funds for a stage show, it was first released as an album in 1970, with the first stage performance not occurring until October 1971. "Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice could not get the money for a stage production."
